summary: The team is balancing urgent SEO and program promotion for Asia Star and Intelligent China with the ongoing knowledge website redesign, while preparing for the CKGSB-IE report launch and Tech in Asia event in September.
summaryDetail: Priority this week is advancing the SEO and program promotion strategy, with Joseph tasked to create a draft of target search areas and the team analyzing Asia Star participants and CRM leads for audience profiles. The knowledge website redesign is in feedback stage, with the decision to remove the videos panel and integrate videos into topic sections; Joseph needs to share the HTML file for further review. Upcoming major initiatives include the CKGSB-IE report launch, with press release and webpage drafts to be shared with IE, and the Tech in Asia event in September, requiring coordination of booth design, session details, and alumni attendance. Additionally, administrative tasks like processing Q4 SEO/SEM invoices and resolving Outlook login issues need attention to ensure smooth operations.
